concepts.def: Catalyst in different phase to reactants.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Fe in Haber (N2 + 3H2 -> 2NH3). V2O5 in Contact (SO2 + 1/2 O2 -> SO3). Ni in alkene hydrogenation.

Pt/Pd/Rh in catalytic converters: 2CO + 2NO -> 2CO2 + N2. Reactants adsorb, react, desorb.

Fe^2+/Fe^3+ catalyses S2O8^2- + 2I- -> 2SO4^2- + I2.

Step 1: S2O8^2- + 2Fe^2+ -> 2SO4^2- + 2Fe^3+. Step 2: 2Fe^3+ + 2I- -> 2Fe^2+ + I2. Net is original equation; Fe regenerated.

5C2O4^2- + 2MnO4- + 16H+ -> 10CO2 + 2Mn^2+ + 8H2O. Mn^2+ product catalyses the reaction.

Rate is initially slow, accelerates as Mn^2+ accumulates, then slows again as reactants run out.
